visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a vibrant red sari stands outdoors at night, surrounded by several local children and teenagers. They are all smiling and waving at the camera. The background is a brightly lit event space with large stage lights and a traditional architectural structure decorated with patterns. (2) A digital screen recording shows the website 'JoinMyWedding', displaying various listings of Indian weddings with photos of couples. (3) The woman is now indoors, standing with a groom wearing a traditional white and gold sherwani and turban. They pose against a green screen-like background. (4) In a hotel room, an assistant helps the woman wrap her red sari. Later, she is seen from the back as her hair is braided into an intricate bun with flowers. (5) Arriving at the wedding venue at night, the woman walks through a grand floral archway illuminated with bright pink neon lights. The floor has a black and white chevron pattern. (6) A wide shot shows the main seating area with rows of white chairs on green artificial turf under a night sky. (7) Fireworks explode on a street at night as a parade approaches. Men in pink turbans are seen playing instruments. (8) The groom is shown sitting on a horse-drawn float, looking somewhat weary. People around him are dancing and cheering. (9) Trays of traditional Indian food, including a large vat of yellow dal or curry, are being served. The woman is seen eating at a table with several local women and children. (10) On a stage filled with theatrical fog, the bride in a dark red lehenga and the groom stand together. Sparklers shoot up into the air around them. (11) A group photo shows the woman in red with several other female guests in sparkling dresses, all waving cheerfully.
